disclosure: Fixed stock synthetic voices, exact delivered clips with one-second gaps. Technical audition, not perceptual acceptance.

intervals.speaker: Nia Pell
intervals.direction: A direct question about whose labor the player is promising.
intervals.text: Tell me whose work you're offering.

intervals.speaker: Nia Pell
intervals.direction: Keep the known-room breach separate from retaining her recording.
intervals.text: They know the room. Don't tell the wall I was protected because you still have my words.

intervals.speaker: Nia Pell
intervals.direction: Acknowledge the later quiet room without erasing the first exposure.
intervals.text: The second room is quiet. The first one still gets calls. Both belong in your account.

intervals.speaker: Kerr
intervals.direction: An understated challenge under the same awning.
intervals.text: or you can walk past and let the canal be the argument.

intervals.speaker: Kerr
intervals.direction: Firm practical collection terms; no invented medical miracle.
intervals.text: I want the case, not a treatment report. Their free courier gate writes the recipient into the shift register. If you promise to keep my name out, don't save your fare by putting it in.

intervals.speaker: Kerr
intervals.direction: Dry humor about the help he can actually offer.
intervals.text: The knee won't hold a wheel. The door I can do.

intervals.speaker: Kerr
intervals.direction: A modest contribution that does not settle past conduct.
intervals.text: You told me the names. This time I kept a door open. That doesn't settle the rest of my week.

intervals.speaker: Mara
intervals.direction: Calmly distinguish entering a response from being absolved.
intervals.text: An answer is not an acquittal,

intervals.speaker: Mara
intervals.direction: The desk received the response; its inquiry remains unanswered.
intervals.text: That was what I wanted my name there for.

intervals.speaker: Mara
intervals.direction: Ordinary agency after the player declined before promising.
intervals.text: I'll find another way to send it.

intervals.speaker: Mara
intervals.text: Don't put an answer where the waiting is.

intervals.speaker: Sera
intervals.direction: A patient invitation to inspect or explain, without demanding a finale.
intervals.text: The third row needs your eye, or help from the wards. You can try. You can also tell me why you came.
